name: aocs-ew-system
description: Advanced Active Camouflage & Electronic Warfare System (AOCS-EW)

scripts.build: g++ -std=c++20 -O3 src/optimized_pipeline.cpp tests/test_aocs_ew_regression.cpp -o build_test_regression && g++ -std=c++20 -O3 src/optimized_pipeline.cpp tests/test_edge_cases.cpp -o build_test_edge && g++ -std=c++20 -O3 src/optimized_pipeline.cpp tests/test_performance.cpp -o build_test_perf
scripts.smoke: python3 -c "import subprocess; res = subprocess.run(['./build_test_regression'], capture_output=True); print(res.stdout.decode()); assert res.returncode == 0"
